_shared_style: Cel-shaded cartoon game asset in the iconic art style of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker (GameCube 2002): bold flat saturated colors with exactly two tones per surface - one bright sunlit tone and one hard-edged shadow tone, NO gradients, NO soft airbrushed shading, NO photorealism. Thick confident dark outlines around every silhouette and major interior edge. Soft rounded toylike shapes - NO sharp low-poly facets. Cheerful storybook palette: vivid spring greens, warm browns, deep playful ocean blues. Small painterly accents (curls, swirls, specks) instead of texture noise. True 2:1 dimetric isometric projection (classic Monument Valley angle), sunlight from the upper-back-left producing crisp cel shadow boundaries. The subject FLOATS with absolutely no ground plane beneath it, no cast shadow on the ground, no surroundings, no border, no text. Background is pure flat solid chroma-green #00FF00 (RGB 0,255,0) filling the entire frame uniformly - NOT gradient, NOT yellow, NOT olive, NOT forest green. Single saturated chroma green edge to edge.
